editorialNotes: Shane's distressed dialogue keeps its pauses, doubled internal space, emotion markers, stutter and hiccup emphasis.
Fortune-teller lines retain their source distinctions while using gender-neutral Bulgarian for the player and arbitrary friend, so no new event control marker is introduced.
Gift article fragment {1} is adjacent to the item {0}; installed-game Lexicon returns an empty article for mod languages, so Bulgarian does not render a stray space.
